brand.name: Atelier47
brand.tagline: Engagement rings made with you, on 47th Street.
brand.shortDescription: A private custom jewelry atelier in the Diamond District. Design your engagement ring with the people who will make it.

contact.entryNote: Building lobby security asks for a photo ID. Tell the desk you are visiting Atelier47, Suite 1200. Take the east elevators.
contact.transit: B, D, F, M to 47-50 Sts Rockefeller Center. 7 to 5 Av. A two minute walk from either.

consultation.retainerCopy: A $250 design retainer reserves your hour with a designer and a bench jeweler. It is credited in full toward your commission. If we cannot make the piece you want, we refund it.
consultation.refundCopy: Reschedule free up to 24 hours ahead. Cancel more than 48 hours ahead for a full refund.

types.label: Earrings, pendant or other fine jewelry

pricingGuide.note: Illustrative ranges for a G to H color, VS2 to SI1 center stone. Your quote follows the consultation and the stone you choose.

team.name: Ilana Roth
team.bio: Ilana trained at a Rhode Island casting house before opening the atelier in 2009. She sits in on every first consultation and draws the first sketch by hand while you talk.

team.name: Teodor Vasquez
team.bio: Teodor sets every center stone under the microscope and checks each prong twice before it leaves his bench. He likes clients to see their stone go in.

team.name: Sun-hee Park
team.bio: Sun-hee turns the sketch into a rotating 3D model you can approve on your phone. She will adjust a gallery rail by a tenth of a millimeter if you ask.

team.name: Elias Mendel
team.bio: Elias cleans up each casting, fits the band, and gives the final polish. He also handles resizing and repairs for anything we have made.

team.name: Priya Raman
team.bio: Priya is your single point of contact. She sources the stone shortlist, sends every update, and answers WhatsApp messages the same day.
